contract_pass_rate.rationale: The smallest deterministic suites contain one case, so one-case quantization is 1.0. These are safety and contract checks: allowing one failed case would defeat the absolute fail-closed rule, so the tolerated movement is zero.

queue_coverage.rationale: The committed queue has 107 required coverage units; one-unit quantization is 1/107 (about 0.00935). Exact case IDs and per-kind counts are checked separately, so this tolerance cannot hide a removed or substituted queue item.
